iconicAnchor.label: MoMA's white-walled modern gallery standard
iconicAnchor.creatorOrTradition: Modern museum exhibition design and the white-cube gallery
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: MoMA describes chromatically simple white galleries as an influential international display norm and shows that even the exact shade is an intentional exhibition-design decision.

sources.title: Small Steps Lead to Bigger Changes: MoMA's Shifting Wall Colors
supports: White-walled space became an international norm for modern and contemporary art display.
Subtle wall color and controlled neutrality are deliberate design decisions rather than an absence of design.

sources.title: Exhibition Design Innovations That Help Us Think about Art Differently
supports: Exhibition design shapes how a visitor perceives, sequences, and relates works within a gallery.
The gallery should support art and visitor understanding rather than merely supply an empty white background.
